Chapter 859: Chapter 6 Domination (Subscribe Please)

Tuoba Ancient God’s confidence originated from a supreme weapon that the Insect Race had temporarily lent to him.

Tuoba Ancient God was an Eleventh Rank of the fifth tier, who had comprehended the Fifth Realm of space and time and possessed the initial ability to refine the supreme weapon.

To strengthen the foundations in the alliance’s large-scale battlefields, the Insect Race started lending their treasure trove of supreme weapons as much as possible.

But it was only a loan; they still needed to be returned afterward.

And this supreme weapon was also Tuoba Ancient God’s greatest source of confidence.

Within the Time Chamber opened by the Insect Race, Tuoba Ancient God had spent thousands of years and successfully refined the supreme weapon initially.

With the supreme weapon in hand, Tuoba Ancient God dared to send his true self, accepting the Insect Race’s invitation.

After all, armed with a supreme weapon, Tuoba Ancient God considered himself absolutely safe. Who could kill him, wielding such a weapon, if not a twelfth rank?

Even if faced with other Eleventh Level Perfect beings who also wielded supreme weapons, using the power of those weapons, they could at best suppress or expel him.

As for utterly defeating him?

Ever since the birth of the universe countless eons ago, there had never been an instance of an Eleventh Rank with a supreme weapon falling at the hands of another Eleventh Rank.

“Do you understand the risks?”

The Ancient God who reminded Tuoba fell silent for a while, “Indeed, the supreme weapon is very strong, but your avatar in the Two-dimensional World also wielded a supreme weapon, yet it still perished in the end.”

“The Two-dimensional World is not the same as the cosmic battlefields.”

Tuoba Ancient God frowned, “In the Two-dimensional World, the might of the supreme weapon could not be fully unleashed; otherwise, that human Xueyu could never have killed me.”

Having said that.

The Ancient God who had warned Tuoba chose to remain silent.

He just offered his advice, whether Tuoba Ancient God listened or not was no longer his concern.

The supreme weapon was indeed mighty, offering an ultimate ability to protect oneself, but nothing is absolute. Sending one’s true self into a large-scale battlefield was indeed somewhat risky.

Watching the Ancient God leave, Tuoba Ancient God continued to commune with that supreme weapon within his body.

“As long as I help the Insect Race gain an advantage on the large-scale battlefield, I will obtain the treasure that I desire, which will not only compensate for the foundational loss of my spirit and will but also might enable me to advance further, to reach Eleventh Level Perfect.”

A hint of desire surfaced in Tuoba Ancient God’s heart.

Not every Eleventh Rank could achieve perfection.

Although reaching the fifth tier of the Eleventh Rank could challenge the ultimate, the hope was slim, and certainly, reaching Perfection was best.

If it were not for the opening of this large-scale battlefield, the Insect Race would not have released that treasure. Tuoba Ancient God knew well that this opportunity might only come once for him.

That’s why Tuoba Ancient God risked sending his true self and accepted the Insect Race’s invitation.

“Even without my help, the Insect Race is likely to gain an advantage on the battlefield,” Tuoba Ancient God silently thought.

As one of the peak races of the universe, there is no need to speak of the Insect Race’s foundations. Previously, in the Two-dimensional World, all extraordinary powers were suppressed, causing the Insect Race’s ability to breed Insect Race Warriors to suffer unprecedented weakening.

Thus in the Two-dimensional World, the presence of the Insect Race wasn’t strong.

But on the cosmic battlefields? That was the main battlefield of the Insect Race, where they could freely breed powerful Insect Race Warriors.

They could even breed billions upon billions of Insect Race Warriors in advance and then take them into battle.

Tuoba Ancient God even felt that by just coasting in the battlefield, he could obtain the treasure he longed for.

“If I encounter that human ‘Xueyu’ again on the battlefield, I’ll just retreat,” Tuoba Ancient God had no thoughts of revenge.

In his view, human Xueyu was very likely a human civilization’s Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver.

In this large-scale Battlefields of Different Races, human Xueyu would surely wield a supreme weapon, and there was no need for him to compete against such an adversary, even if he had the means to save himself.

“I heard that the Galaxy Master has also stepped into Eleventh Rank.”

Thinking about human Xueyu, Tuoba Ancient God then thought of the Galaxy Master, knowing that his current predicament was largely thanks to the Galaxy Master.

If it weren’t for the Galaxy Master’s rapid progress, causing Tuoba Ancient God to feel threatened, he wouldn’t have agreed to join the large-scale battlefield, and thus wouldn’t have been sucked into the Two-dimensional World by White Paper.

“To reach Eleventh Rank in such a short time…” Tuoba Ancient God couldn’t help feeling envious. As a special lifeform nurtured by the Cosmic Starry Skies, Tuoba’s talents and aptitude were beyond question.

But compared with the Galaxy Master, he was undoubtedly outshone, as the Galaxy Master had only taken a few hundred years to reach the tenth rank, while he had spent tens of millions to billions of years to step into the Eleventh Rank.

“Such rapid progress, the foundation must not be solid, and the hopes of reaching the ultimate are slim,” Tuoba Ancient God’s eyes narrowed slightly, “If I encounter him on the large-scale battlefield this time, I might give him a profound lesson.”

The Galaxy Master stepping into the Eleventh Rank was not entirely bad news. At least Tuoba Ancient God felt that the other party was very likely to join the large-scale Battlefields of Different Races.

If the Galaxy Master was only at Rank Ten, under the protection of human civilization, there would be no chance for him to make contact with him.

But now, Tuoba Ancient God had an opportunity.

…

Tianyu Clan territory.

At the highest point, the towering ancestral figures of the Tianyu feathered race looked down below.

One after another, Tianyu Clan’s Eleventh Rank Godlords stood tall, desiring to gain control of the large-scale battlefield, representing many benefits to be reaped.

Rustle.

A Heavenly Lord with twenty pairs of wings on her back appeared, a woman of perfect appearance with a holy aura, wearing a saintly crown on her head.

“This large-scale battlefield, our Tianyu Clan will surely not disappoint the ancestors.”

The perfectly comely woman was named ‘Tianyu Meng’; being able to have ‘Tianyu’ as a surname indicated the most noble bloodline, carrying the blood of the very first ancestor.

“Be wary of the Yu Clan…” The first ancestor from the highest point spoke, his voice a thunderous roar.

“Yes.”

Tianyu Meng nodded; she was the most promising member of the Tianyu Clan to strive for the ultimate existence. Her bloodline originated from the very first ancestor, and this time she carried with her the Tribal Guardian Weapon of the Tianyu Clan—

The Angelic Crown.

Tianyu Meng had already planned to make her mark in the grand-scale Battlefields of Different Races.

Even among the most powerful weapons, the Angelic Crown was considered top-notch. It was forged from a treasure that fell into the Cosmos shortly after the first ancestor of the Tianyu Clan was born.

Only someone like Tianyu Meng, with the blood of the first ancestor flowing in her veins, could refine such a formidable weapon. No one else, not even a Level Eleven Perfect, could achieve such a feat.

Consequently, the might of the Angelic Crown was immense, surpassing that of the other powerful weapons. The power Tianyu Meng could unleash with it was also higher than other Eleventh Level Perfect wielders of such weapons.

…

The Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan made many arrangements and strategic plans for the grand-scale battlefield.

The Yu Clan, the Star Alliance, and other peak forces did the same, as the outcome of the grand-scale battlefield would determine the division of resource enclaves within the universe for the next several million years.

Every clan and force attached great importance to it.

…

Xia You Evolution Tower.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit hurried over.

At this moment, the place was already filled with numerous Eleventh Level Evolvers, all under the command of Xia Qin, the supreme powerhouse.

The nine Evolution Towers of human civilization each control a portion of the Evolvers, making them factions of sorts.

Of course, within human civilization, due to the constraints set by the three goddesses and the guidance of the nine powerhouses, there were hardly any significant struggles.

All contradictions and conflicts were resolved at the very beginning.

“Who is that?”

“It’s the Galaxy Master.”

“The Galaxy Master has come too.”

As soon as Lin Yuan entered the Xia You Evolution Tower, he drew the attention of many Eleventh Level Evolvers, most of whom had seen him at a gathering not long before.

“Galaxy Master.”

Nalan, the deputy master of the tower, flew over and greeted Lin Yuan.

“Are there many Level Elevens you don’t recognize?” Nalan asked in a low voice, pulling Lin Yuan aside.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded. Anyone who reached the status of an Eleventh Level Evolver was essentially a highly influential figure within human civilization and would have celebrated an Eleventh Level ceremony.

Even if Lin Yuan had not taken part, he had at least heard of them.

“These Eleventh Level Evolvers have been secretly trained by the supreme powerhouses,” Nalan said, having only found out himself not long ago.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded. His gaze swept over the many Eleventh Level Evolvers, and he could faintly sense the presence of powerful weapons surging within some of them.

Once an Evolver reached the fifth category of Level Eleven, human civilization would typically equip them with a powerful weapon.

Of course, it was a loan, and upon returning from the grand-scale battlefield, they would need to return it to human civilization.

Xia Qin, the supreme powerhouse, had once asked Lin Yuan if he needed a powerful weapon, but Lin Yuan declined.

The so-called powerful weapons—Lin Yuan already had quite a few. Refining a few more would not significantly enhance his strength.

Rather than wasting them on Lin Yuan, it would be better to equip another Eleventh Level fifth category Evolver with one.

Next.

One after another, Eleventh Level Evolvers came up to greet Lin Yuan.

Everyone was an Evolver from the Xia You Evolution Tower, and it was natural for them to be close to one another.

Time passed.

Another month flew by in the blink of an eye.

Hum.

A majestic figure condensed, and the oppressive presence of a supreme powerhouse spread out.

“Supreme powerhouse.”

All Eleventh Level Evolvers in the area stood up and looked towards the newly appeared Xia Qin, the supreme powerhouse.

“The time is nearly upon us.”

Xia Qin, the supreme powerhouse, looked around and said, “I don’t need to elaborate on the importance of the grand-scale battlefield.”

“Now, I will make some assignments.”

After saying this, Xia Qin paused for a moment before continuing, “All Eleventh Level Evolvers of Xia You Evolution Tower will follow the command of one person in the battlefield.”

In wars between clans, except for the formidable Level Twelves, everyone else must obey commands and only through such organization can they exert their greatest strength.

“Galaxy Master.”

Xia Qin’s tone was calm, and his gaze fell on Lin Yuan, who was standing in a corner.

As soon as these words were spoken.

Many Eleventh Level Evolvers on the scene were shocked, turning their gaze to Lin Yuan, the recently advanced Level Eleven Galaxy Master.
